name: Mali
prevalence_note: Orange Mali tells customers never to type a code dictated in a prize-style message, never to give the Orange Money secret code even to someone claiming to work for Orange, and never to say a withdrawal number out loud. Orange Money Mali has also warned the public to ignore deposit or transfer SMS that do not come from the official OrangeMoney sender.
cross_border_note: Calls and SMS are usually in French or Bambara and may use Malian mobiles; some lures also misuse the name of the regional central bank that covers Mali.

scams.name: Annonce de gain et code à taper
scams.name_en: Prize announcement with a dictated code

red_flag_keywords.text: asks the user to type a sequence presented as the way to collect a prize
announces a win and asks the customer to confirm a dictated sequence
claims the prize will lapse unless a code is entered at once

scams.signals_en: A call, SMS or email framed as a prize or jackpot tells the customer in Bamako or elsewhere in Mali to type a code the caller is dictating, which can empty the Orange Money wallet.
scams.legit_en: Orange Mali's official protection page says never to type a code dictated by someone on the phone, by SMS or by email, including when the request is presented as a prize announcement.
bait_tactics: Je n'ai pas pris part à un jeu Orange Mali, donc je ne tape aucune séquence pour un prétendu lot.
Aucun avis de gain n'apparaît dans le menu officiel de ce compte à Bamako.
Je refuse de saisir un code annoncé par un appel, même présenté comme un cadeau.

scams.name: Demande du code secret Orange Money
scams.name_en: Request for the Orange Money secret code

red_flag_keywords.text: solicits the Orange Money secret code while claiming to represent Orange Mali
asks the customer to dictate the secret code to a supposed staff member
asks the cash-out reference to be spoken on the call

scams.signals_en: Someone posing as Orange staff asks the customer to say the wallet secret code or to read a withdrawal number aloud, sometimes at a kiosk or during an unsolicited call.
scams.legit_en: Orange Mali states that the secret code must never be given to a third party, including a person claiming to be from Orange, and that Orange will never ask for it. It also tells customers not to say a withdrawal number out loud.
bait_tactics: Le code secret de ce portefeuille ne sera pas dicté, Orange Mali ne le réclame pas au téléphone.
Je n'énonce pas un numéro de retrait dans cette pièce, trop de monde peut l'entendre.
Je n'ai demandé aucun déblocage de compte, cette conversation s'arrête là sur ce point.

scams.name: Faux SMS de dépôt n'venant pas d'OrangeMoney
scams.name_en: Fake deposit SMS not sent as OrangeMoney

red_flag_keywords.text: treats an unofficial deposit SMS as proof of a credit and demands a refund
insists a message is valid even though the sender is not the official name
demands an immediate repayment of a transfer that does not appear in the wallet

scams.signals_en: An SMS that looks like a deposit or transfer notice arrives from a sender that is not the official OrangeMoney name, then a caller asks the customer to forward the apparent credit.
scams.legit_en: Orange Money Mali has told the public not to treat any deposit or transfer message as genuine unless the sender is OrangeMoney, and to report such messages promptly.
bait_tactics: Ce SMS de dépôt n'affiche pas l'expéditeur officiel OrangeMoney, je ne m'en sers pas pour un renvoi.
Le solde réel de ce compte n'a pas bougé après ce message.
Je signale ce type de SMS plutôt que de transférer mon propre argent.
